_doc: 20 GuacScore scenarios — shared between the web Node runner and the mobile Dart test. Each scenario lists receipts (with a relative-day offset from today and total_amount + rating) plus bank_fees. The runner sets `today` per execution, then derives ISO dates, runs the engine across surfaces (dashboard = lifetime, /guacanomics 30d / 90d / 12mo / all), and reports the score per surface. Cross-platform parity is asserted by both runners producing identical scores for every scenario.

scenarios.title: Brand-new user — no rated receipts
scenarios.description: User just signed up, has no ratings yet. Score should be null and the UI shows the 'Just Starting' placeholder.

scenarios.title: Single 5★ receipt
scenarios.description: One rated purchase, 5 stars. Score should peg at 100 ('Smash Master').

scenarios.title: Single 1★ regret
scenarios.description: One rated purchase, 1 star. Score should bottom at 0 ('Just Starting').

scenarios.title: Single 3★ neutral
scenarios.description: One purchase rated middle-of-the-road. Score should land at 50 ('Treat Mode').

scenarios.title: Equal-weight 5★ and 1★ → balances to 50
scenarios.description: Two receipts of equal dollar amount, one 5★ one 1★. Should land at exactly 50.

scenarios.title: Big 5★ outweighs small 1★
scenarios.description: $500 essential outweighs $5 regret. Score should be very close to 100.

scenarios.title: Big 1★ regret drags score down
scenarios.description: One $1000 regret + several small 4★ smart buys. Score lands low because the regret dominates the weighted average.

scenarios.title: Many neutral 3★ buys
scenarios.description: Ten receipts all rated 3★. Score stays at 50.

scenarios.title: All 5★ across many receipts
scenarios.description: User rates 8 purchases all as essentials. Score pegs 100.

scenarios.title: All 1★ — heavy regret
scenarios.description: Every rated purchase is 1★. Score bottoms at 0.

scenarios.title: Mixed ratings + small bank fee penalty
scenarios.description: Mostly 4★ + a small annual fee. Score is high but penalized 1-2 points.

scenarios.title: Huge bank fees relative to spend → -25 penalty cap
scenarios.description: $30 essential + $500 interest. Penalty must cap at the documented max of -25 regardless of how lopsided the ratio is.

scenarios.title: Interest-only stings more than fees-only per dollar
scenarios.description: $100 5★ + $50 interest. Per-dollar coefficient is 1/25 for interest vs 1/50 for fees, so interest produces a bigger penalty than the same dollar amount in fees.

scenarios.title: Fees-only — lighter penalty than the equivalent interest
scenarios.description: Same spend / same dollar bank-bite as the prior scenario, but the bite is all fees (no interest). Penalty should be SMALLER than the interest-only case.

scenarios.title: Returns (negative amounts) don't drag the score
scenarios.description: User returns a $200 5★ purchase. The negative total_amount is excluded from the rated set, so the remaining 1★ regret defines the score.

scenarios.title: Statement-import card payments filtered out
scenarios.description: User has 2 real purchases + 3 imported card-payment rows (store_name '[card payment] AmEx'). isPaymentReceipt must strip the payment rows before scoring.

scenarios.title: Old receipts excluded from /guacanomics 30d view
scenarios.description: User has one 1★ regret from 200 days ago + recent 5★ buys. Dashboard tile (lifetime) shows a blended score; /guacanomics 30d shows pure 5★. Demonstrates scope-driven divergence.

scenarios.title: Receipt at exactly the 90-day boundary
scenarios.description: Receipt date is exactly 90 days ago. With the midnight-snap fix it should be INCLUDED in the 90d window (>=since), not flicker based on the time of day the user opened the page.

scenarios.title: Lifetime high, 30-day low — scope divergence is expected
scenarios.description: User had a great year (lifetime 90+) but their last 30 days were all impulse buys (regret-heavy). Dashboard tile = lifetime score (high), /guacanomics 30d = recent score (low). This DIVERGENCE IS A FEATURE — both are correct.

scenarios.title: Receipts exist but none are rated yet
scenarios.description: User has 5 purchases logged but hasn't rated any. Score is null because `rating != null` filter excludes them all.
